name: HVAC Package Unit Installation
summary:
HVAC Package Unit Installation is an immersive VR training application designed to simulate real-world installation procedures for HVAC package units. Learners engage in step-by-step, hands-on scenarios covering equipment positioning, connections, safety protocols, and system checks in a risk-free virtual environment.
